Keep sub under 120 characters. look (the website only; the app ignores it) = the tile on the Games page and in the games' Games menu: c1/c2 colours, a white glyph (SVG in a 24 x 24 box), the store its scores are kept under, cover (a card game's cover picture, games/img/covers/<id>-v<cover>.svg) and added (a New ribbon for 30 days).

games.title: Spider
games.sub: Build each suit from King to Ace. One suit to four, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: TriPeaks
games.sub: Clear three peaks with cards one higher or lower. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Pyramid
games.sub: Take away pairs that make 13 until the pyramid has gone. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Hearts
games.sub: The Windows classic against three computer players: dodge the Queen of spades. A Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Gin Rummy
games.sub: Make sets and runs, then knock or go Gin against the computer. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Cribbage
games.sub: The pub classic against the computer, every hand counted for you. Four levels, a Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: Whist
games.sub: Classic whist with a computer partner: trumps turned up, two games the rubber. A Hall of Fame and a 100-level Journey.

games.title: 365 Invaders
games.sub: Our own 80s arcade shooter, with power-ups, combos and a Mothership boss. A gentle speed and a Hall of Fame.

games.title: 365 Bat & Ball
games.sub: Knock out the bricks: 20 levels, exploding bricks, lasers, three balls, two Motherships and a Hall of Fame.

games.title: 365 Eclipse
games.sub: A 3D jet shooter: seven stages from harbour to orbit, four fighters, new guns and rockets to catch, and huge bosses.

games.title: 365 Coast Run
games.sub: A 3D road race along the Dorset coast with your girlfriend beside you: fifteen places, five goals - drift, jump and do what she asks for hearts.

games.title: Seafront
games.sub: Ride an eFoil, jet ski or RIB along the real Bournemouth seafront. Best on a newer PC.
